Q: ow do I break down a deep learning project into smaller steps as a beginner? A:

You’re truly ready when you stop asking 'how do I fix this syntax error?' and start asking 'how is this function altering my data's distribution?' Readiness means writing memory efficient, reproducible scripts, and treating missing data as a statistical problem to solve rather than a code error to bypass.

Q: Is it possible to edit/change a resource file within a Jar in Java? A:

A JAR file is-a Zip with extra bits. So it is technically possible to do this, but it is strongly discouraged! Because a JAR file is generally intended to be an immutable artifact. Instead, read and write to resource files in System.getProperty("user.home") (which is going to give you the path to the user's home folder).

Q: AI makes me stop upgrading my skills, ended up making a vibe coder rather than a actual coder A:

This is critical for modern iOS. Swift and SwiftUI evolve so fast that LLMs constantly blend deprecated code with new APIs like @Observable. If you vibe-code Apple's ecosystem, you'll inherit a brittle, outdated codebase. You must read the official documentation to know current best practices before letting AI write any Swift.
